blind_spots: No post-August operating filing was available through the SEC submissions check.
The bounded review did not obtain an independent current construction audit or an issuer-independent lithium-price scenario set.
The review did not infer undisclosed information from price action.
contrary_evidence: Q2 primary evidence showed construction progress, substantial liquidity and unchanged late-2027/2028 schedule targets.
The Yorkville convertible financing added liquidity while also increasing equity-linked claim and dilution complexity.
adversarial_review.effect_on_conclusion: The alternative keeps confidence low and reinforces watch/ineligible rather than supporting a BUY or a valuation scenario.
adversarial_review.falsification_condition: A subsequent primary filing showing a material cost increase, schedule slip, funding shortfall, commissioning problem or adverse lithium-price sensitivity that was already developing during the alert window would falsify the no-new-filed-catalyst interpretation.
adversarial_review.favored_hypothesis: The October alert cluster reflects severe negative price momentum without a newly filed issuer operating catalyst; project execution, financing and commodity risks still prevent treating the lower price as an investable opportunity.
adversarial_review.reason: Primary issuer and SEC records were inspected, but contrary-source search was partial because no independent current construction audit or comparable current project model was available in scope.
adversarial_review.strongest_alternative: The selloff may anticipate material undisclosed construction, funding, commissioning or lithium-market deterioration that the August operating package and September non-operating filing cannot reveal.
